title: GeoNames postal subset licence and quality limits
summary: Primary postal readme consulted. It declares CC-BY-4.0 while linking CC-BY3.0, and GB_full adds Royal Mail2022 copyright/database rights. Blanket redistribution remains needs-review. Near100 countries; Irish/Chilean/Maltese/Chinese codes can be truncated, Brazil mostly major codes. Coordinates can be calculated averages with accuracy flags. country+postcode can name multiple places. No postal dump downloaded.
